name: tensixinet
description: Your Tenstorrent chips, playing in a band: tensixinet reads each chip's telemetry with tt-smi (temperature, clock, power, current, memory temperatures, harvesting, link state, errors) and turns it into music from eleven synthesizers inspired by Ciat-Lonbarde instruments, so a hot chip and a cool chip sound different, a busy chip gets more solos, and uneven memory makes the melody wander. Every mapping is logged with its reason, each run draws a replayable patch, a live mode follows the chips as they heat under a prompted language model, some devices run as TT-Lang kernels on the chips themselves, and a Gradio page draws the band as it plays. Needs no hardware to try: it plays any number of synthetic chips.
